title: 第7章 你有三罪第8章 一剑足矣
content_zh:
“七星步！”
秦浩脚踏七星，轻松躲过一头一级初阶妖兽白豹狼的攻击，而后右手轻轻一挥。
刷！
一抹剑光闪过，他手中铁剑从白豹狼脖颈处掠去。
噗嗤一声，白豹狼哀嚎一声，倒在地上抽搐几下，彻底没了声息。
几乎同时，呛地一声，铁剑又回归剑鞘。
“七星步大成！”
“《拔剑术》大成！”
秦浩眼中精光一闪，“半个月不到，两门黄级中阶武技大成，整个天水城有史以来也未曾有人做到。”
半月以来，秦浩疯狂磨砺自己，四处寻找妖兽实战。
甚至遇到一级中阶妖兽，一番激战，最终饮恨秦浩剑下。
相比半月前，秦浩实力可谓突飞猛进。
两门黄级中阶武技，全部达到大成之境。
“今日，是我和秦方约战之日。”
“我出来这半个月，还不知道秦高池和秦方，会如何逼迫父亲！”
“该回去了。”
秦浩握紧拳头。
将白豹狼锐齿和利爪切下，装入包裹，随即他脚步轻点，几个起落便消失不见。
秦浩不知道，柳狂此时已然回到天水城柳家。
只不过此刻的柳狂，哪里还有半分意气风发，衣着破烂，披头散发，如同乞丐。

只是，他的气势也越发狂暴。
为了寻找秦浩，柳狂深入墨林山脉，击杀了不少妖兽，自己也狼狈不堪。
最终一无所获，只能返回柳家。
房间内除了柳狂外，床上还躺着瘫痪着的柳峰，以及柳家大长老柳乘风。
“父亲，二弟怎么样？”
柳狂咬牙道。
“峰儿丹田破碎，双腿压迫性损伤，只怕以后都站不起来了。”
柳乘风沉声道。
柳峰红着眼睛：“都是秦浩，这个垃圾，杂种，我要他死，我一定要他死，大哥，你一定要为我报仇，一定要他碎尸万段！
让他求生不得求死不能！”
柳狂满脸狰狞，“我在墨林山脉没找到他，估计是早早回到了秦家，二弟，你在这等着，我现在就去秦家，拿秦浩项上人头给你！”
“站住！”
柳乘风沉喝道：“万象天才战马上就要开始，你现在哪也不能去！”
柳狂怒道：“那二弟的仇怎么办？”
柳乘风冷哼一声，“秦浩和秦方约战就在今日，以秦方三品武魂的资质，对付区区一个秦浩轻而易举，秦家大长老秦高池准备趁此机会驱逐秦浩，逼迫秦云天放弃家主之位。”
“只要秦浩被逐出秦家，以后有的是机会杀他。
当务之急，是万象天才战，狂儿你是我柳家仅此柳若雪的天才，此次万象天才战你务必争夺前三，进入万象殿。”
“如此，我柳家便又有两位万象殿弟子，他日必然超过秦家和陈家，成为天水城第一大家族！”
“所以，这段时间你哪里也不能去，给我安心修炼，我已经跟族长商量好，以全族之力为你提供资源！”
天水城共有三大家族，秦家、陈家和柳家。

三家互相钳制，互相针对！
躺在床上的柳峰脸上满是憋屈之色，他很后悔，后悔招惹秦浩，后悔自己不自量力想羞辱秦浩。
柳峰憋屈道：“大哥，你就听父亲的吧，万象天才战三年举办一次，错过这次又得等三年，等你进入万象殿，再为我报仇不迟，那个时候我一定要将秦浩千刀万剐。”
content_en:
"Seven Star Steps!"
Qin Hao stepped on the seven stars and easily dodged the attack of a first-level elementary monster white leopard wolf, and then waved his right hand lightly.
brush!
A flash of sword light flashed, and the iron sword in his hand swept away from the white leopard wolf's neck.
With a puff, the white leopard wolf howled, fell to the ground and twitched a few times, becoming completely silent.
Almost at the same time, with a choking sound, the iron sword returned to its scabbard.
"Seven Star Steps are completed!"
"The Art of Drawing the Sword is completed!"
Qin Hao's eyes flashed, "In less than half a month, he has mastered two yellow-level intermediate martial arts. No one has ever achieved this in the entire history of Tianshui City."
For half a month, Qin Hao has been training himself crazily, looking for monsters everywhere to fight.
He even encountered a first-level mid-level monster, fought fiercely, and finally fell under Qin Hao's sword.
Compared with half a month ago, Qin Hao's strength has improved by leaps and bounds.
The two yellow-level intermediate martial arts have all reached the state of great achievement.
"Today is the day when Qin Fang and I have an appointment to fight."
"I've been out for half a month, but I still don't know how Qin Gaochi and Qin Fang will force my father!"
"It's time to go back."
Qin Hao clenched his fists.
He cut off the sharp teeth and claws of the white leopard wolf and put them into the package. Then he stepped lightly and disappeared after a few ups and downs.
Qin Hao didn't know that Liu Kuang had returned to the Liu family in Tianshui City at this time.
It's just that at this moment, Liu Kuang doesn't have any high spirits, his clothes are in tatters, and his hair is disheveled, like a beggar.
However, his momentum became more and more violent.
In order to find Qin Hao, Liu Kuang went deep into the Molin Mountains and killed many monsters, leaving him in a terrible state.
In the end, he found nothing and had no choice but to return to the Liu family.
In addition to Liu Kuang, there were also paralyzed Liu Feng and Liu Chengfeng, the eldest elder of the Liu family, lying on the bed.
"Father, how is my second brother?"
Liu Kuang gritted his teeth and said.
"Feng'er's dantian was shattered and her legs were compressed. I'm afraid she won't be able to stand up in the future."
Liu Chengfeng said solemnly.
Liu Feng's eyes were red: "It's all Qin Hao, this trash, bastard, I want him to die, I must let him die, brother, you must avenge me, you must cut him into pieces!
Let him live but not die! "
Liu Kuang's face was ferocious, "I didn't find him in the Molin Mountains. He probably returned to the Qin family early. Second brother, you wait here. I will go to the Qin family now and give you Qin Hao's head!"
"Stop!"
Liu Chengfeng shouted solemnly: "The battle of geniuses is about to begin. You can't go anywhere now!"
Liu Kuang said angrily: "What about the second brother's revenge?"
Liu Chengfeng snorted coldly, "Qin Hao and Qin Fang are scheduled to fight today. With Qin Fang's third-grade martial soul qualifications, it is easy to deal with Qin Hao. Qin Gaochi, the elder of the Qin family, is planning to take this opportunity to expel Qin Hao and force Qin Yuntian to give up his position as head of the family."
"As long as Qin Hao is expelled from the Qin family, there will be many opportunities to kill him in the future.
The top priority is the Wanxiang Genius Battle. Kuang'er, you are the only genius in my Liu family after Liu Ruoxue. In this Wanxiang Genius Battle, you must compete for the top three and enter the Wanxiang Hall. "
"In this way, my Liu family will have two more disciples of Wanxiang Hall. They will definitely surpass the Qin family and Chen family in the future and become the largest family in Tianshui City!"
"So, you can't go anywhere during this period, so you can practice with peace of mind. I have already made an agreement with the clan leader to provide you with resources with the full strength of the clan!"
There are three major families in Tianshui City, the Qin family, the Chen family and the Liu family.
The three families are suppressing each other and targeting each other!
Lying on the bed, Liu Feng's face was full of aggrievedness. He regretted provoking Qin Hao and regretted that he overestimated his own capabilities and wanted to humiliate Qin Hao.
Liu Feng said aggrievedly: "Brother, just listen to your father. The Wanxiang Genius Battle is held every three years. If you miss this time, you will have to wait another three years. When you enter the Wanxiang Palace, it will not be too late to avenge me. At that time, I will definitely cut Qin Hao to death with a thousand swords."
